tts/out/adCh/01.mp3: Most people have this backwards. It starts with a conversation, not a laptop, paper, questions, and the time to listen. You type it up afterwards in your own time on a Guardian's own approved form.
tts/out/adCh/02.mp3: Your client reads the draft and agrees with it, then your manager signs it and adds a comment, and then it never stops, a check-in every six months, a full review in their birthday month for life.
